title: Knicks Champions: Who's Rising and Who's Falling After the Title Run

paragraphs.text: The New York Knicks just wrapped up the single most important offseason this franchise has had in more than fifty years.
paragraphs.card_title: The Most Important Offseason in 50 Years

paragraphs.text: Why? Because for the first time since nineteen seventy three, the Larry O'Brien trophy is sitting in Madison Square Garden.
Let that sink in for a second. More than five decades of waiting, of heartbreak, of wait till next year — and it finally happened.
But championships don't just change banners hanging from the rafters. They change how we look at every single player on that roster.
Some guys saw their stock shoot through the roof this summer. Others, fair or not, watched their value take a hit.
Today we're breaking down exactly who's rising and who's falling in the aftermath of this Knicks title run.
And then we're diving deep into the one massive question mark still hanging over this championship roster. Who in the world is playing backup center?
